up: Retrieve a list of all approved drugs (maximum development phase = 4) that have at least one indication related to pain. For each such drug–indication pair, return the following columns: the ChEMBL identifier of the drug (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), the preferred name of the drug (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), the canonical SMILES of the drug (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), the indication identifier (drug_indication.drugind_id), the indication label (drug_indication.mesh_heading), and the maximum development phase (molecule_dictionary.max_phase). Filter drug_indication records so that only those whose mesh_heading (or efo_term) contains the word 'Pain' (case‑insensitive) are included. Join molecule_dictionary with drug_indication on molregno and with compound_structures on molregno. Do not apply any other filters or row limits. Return one row per qualifying drug–indication combination.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.drugind_id, di.mesh_heading, md.max_phase FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND (LOWER(di.mesh_heading) LIKE '%pain%' OR LOWER(di.efo_term) LIKE '%pain%');
